thread:
lina: Hey team — Aurora HSM wants to go into the cloud marketplace and we need to bundle compliance artifacts + plan the joint announcement. Can we align on what we must hand over to the marketplace listing?

sam: For marketplace listing we usually provide: SOC2 Type 2 summary (redacted), third-party pen test report summary, network/architecture diagram, and an attestation letter from partner. Also need contact for vulnerability disclosures.

dorian: From engineering, we need to produce an HSM integration diagram (key flows, KMS boundaries), a list of supported firmware versions, and a small runbook for onboarding their SI connectors.

ashley: Marketing wants a joint announcement window. We can't announce until compliance artifacts are uploaded and legal signs off. Targeting a 2-week runway.

marketplace-bot: checklist created: [SOC2-summary, pen-test-summary, architecture-diagram, attestation, redaction-checklist, presigned-artifacts]. Upload TTL default = 30d.

lina: @sam can you confirm redaction guidance? Aurora will share full reports but we only surface summaries to marketplace.

sam: Redaction guidance: remove IP/secret names, redact customer names, remove detailed exploit PoC steps. Keep scope, controls tested, and remediation status. We provide a 1-2 page executive summary for listing.

pen-test-coordinator: Vendor can produce a marketplace-safe summary template. Need to know if we want a vendor-signed summary or a Redwood-signed attestation referencing the vendor report.

lina: Let's get both: vendor-signed summary + Redwood attestation referencing it. That helps SI partners trust the combo.

dorian: For artifact delivery, we'll accept presigned S3 links. Suggest filename pattern: aurora_hsm/<artifact_type>/<YYYYMMDD>_<owner>.pdf. Example command to generate presign (internal):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-compliance/aurora_hsm/pen-summary/20260315_vendor.pdf --expires-in 2592000
```

ashley: Marketing note — we need a one-paragraph compliance blurb we can share in the announcement. Can security draft a blurb?

sam: Draft blurb: "Aurora HSM and Redwood Inference list with marketplace-compliant controls; SOC2 Type 2-aligned and validated with third-party assessments. See compliance summary for details." (we'll refine).

lina: Scheduling: pen test vendor available week of 2026-04-06 for combined stack scoping. Can eng/SI owners confirm availability?

dorian: Eng can support scoping calls on 2026-04-07 afternoon.

pen-test-coordinator: Noted. We'll send scope doc and questionnaire. Expect a pre-scope questionnaire to be due 3 business days before kickoff.

lina: Action items: (1) Sam to produce redaction template + 1 pg summary by 2026-03-28. (2) Dorian to produce HSM keyflow diagram + firmware list by 2026-03-29. (3) Pen-test vendor to send scope + questionnaire by 2026-03-30. (4) Ashley to draft announcement blurb by 2026-03-31.

sam: I'll own redaction template + blurb draft.

dorian: I'll drop a rough diagram into the secure folder and ping when presigned link is ready.

lina: Also flagging legal: @legal_compliance — need signoff on attestation phrasing. Please advise on required language and whether partner signatory is sufficient.

marketplace-bot: reminder: tag artifacts with classification=restricted. Enable object lock for attestation files.

ashley: Great — once the artifacts are in place, we'll do a dry-run announcement internally before public release.

lina: Thanks everyone. I'll track ownership in the partnership board and post updates here. :thumbsup:
